_README: This is the ONE file to edit for everyday website changes (hours, phone, specials, featured promos, services). See EDITING.md. After saving, the live site updates in about a minute.

business.name: Fusion 3 Salon
business.tagline: An Aveda & Davines salon in downtown Pleasanton

hoursNote: Hours may vary on holidays. Text us anytime.

announcement._help: Optional thin bar at the very top of every page. Set show to false to hide it.
announcement.text: Holiday gift cards are here — the easiest gift you'll give all year.

featured._help: Homepage 'Featured' cards for product launches, promos and events. Add, remove or reorder. 'ends' (YYYY-MM-DD) is optional; the card hides itself after that date. 'image' is optional (put the file in public/images/).
featured.title: Best in East Bay, again
featured.text: Thank you for voting us East Bay Times Best in East Bay 2026 — and for 11 years in the Best of East Bay Hall of Fame.
featured.imageAlt: East Bay Times Best in East Bay 2026 award

featured.title: $20 off your first service with us
featured.text: New to Fusion 3? Here's $20 toward any service you've never had with us before.

featured.title: Give the Fusion 3 experience
featured.text: Gift cards for any amount, delivered by email in minutes.

specials.title: $20 New Guest Offer
specials.text: Here's $20 on us toward any service you've never had with us before.

specials.title: Refer a Friend: They Get $20, You Get $50
specials.text: Send a friend a $20 voucher for their first visit. After they come in, we add a $50 Fusion 3 credit to your account.

specials.title: Gift Cards
specials.text: Share the Fusion 3 experience with the people you love. Any amount, delivered by email.

services.pricingNote: Current prices for every service are shown when you book online. Prices are "starting at" and may vary for very long or thick hair or anything that needs extra time or product. Not sure what you need? Book a complimentary consultation.

groups.name: Cuts & Styling
groups.intro: Every haircut includes a stress-relieving Aveda scalp, neck and shoulder treatment, a luxurious shampoo, light conditioning and a blow-dry style.

items.name: Haircut
items.desc: Includes treatment, shampoo and blow-dry style.

items.name: Child's Cut
items.desc: Ages 12 and under.

items.name: Bang Trim
items.desc: Complimentary for existing guests.

items.name: Blow-Dry Style
items.desc: Shampoo and style, no cut.

items.name: Special Event Styling
items.desc: Up-dos and styling for weddings and events.

items.name: Deep Conditioning
items.desc: Add to any service, or on its own.

items.name: Thermal Styling Add-on
items.desc: Curl or straighten to finish any service.

items.name: Consultation
items.desc: Complimentary for everyone, and required for new guests.

groups.name: Color
groups.intro: We color with Aveda's plant- and flower-derived haircolor.

items.name: Partial Highlight
items.desc: Lighter, brighter dimension on top and around the face — natural or high-contrast.

items.name: Full Highlight
items.desc: Dimension all over, including underneath, for guests who wear their hair up.

items.name: Balayage
items.desc: Hand-painted, soft, lived-in color. Consultation recommended.

items.name: Demi-Color
items.desc: Ammonia-free, 99% plant-derived color that refreshes tone and adds shine. Does not lighten or fully cover grey.

items.name: Permanent Touch-up
items.desc: Root touch-up for single-process color and full grey coverage.

items.name: All-Over Permanent Color
items.desc: First time with color? Beautiful, even color with subtle tonal variation.

items.name: Color Correction
items.desc: Made a mistake? We can help. Consultation required.

items.name: Color Add-ons
items.desc: Add demi-color or a few highlights to any color service.

groups.name: Extensions & Texture
groups.intro: These services require a consultation first so we can plan the right approach for your hair.

items.name: Hair Extensions
items.desc: Great Lengths, tape-in, laced and woven extensions.

items.name: Smoothing & Straightening
items.desc: Brazilian Blowout, relaxing and straightening.

items.name: Permanent Waves
items.desc: Partial, full-head, spiral and specialty perms.

items.name: Brows
items.desc: Shaping and clean-up. First visit includes a brow consultation.

extras: Bridal and event services are available — text us to plan your day.
New Talent stylists are fully licensed cosmetologists completing our in-house certification program, at a lower price point.

policies: Please give at least 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule. Late cancellations and no-shows are charged 50% of the reserved services. Contract appointments (such as bridal) may require longer notice.
A credit card is required to reserve all appointments.
New guests please book a complimentary consultation with your first appointment, so we have time to get to know you.
We love animals, but as a courtesy to all guests, service animals only please.

careers.intro: Love doing hair but feel stuck with an empty book or a commission-only model? At Fusion 3 you're part of a team, not renting a chair: great pay, bonuses for exceeding guests' expectations, a high-end clientele, ongoing education and the room to grow quickly.

roles.title: Hair Stylists
roles.text: Experienced stylists who want a high-end clientele, a supportive team and room to grow.

roles.title: New Talent Stylists
roles.text: Newly licensed? Our in-house certification program gets you on the floor fast with real mentorship.

roles.title: Salon Coordinators
roles.text: Warm, upbeat people who love making a great first impression and keeping the day running smoothly.

careers.applyText: Email your résumé to pleasanton@fusion3salon.com or stop by the salon.

vouchers._help: Wording and fine print for the printable/shareable voucher pages at /specials/new-guest/ and /specials/refer/.

newGuest.headline: $20 toward your first service
newGuest.text: Try something you've never had with us before — a cut, color, balayage, waxing or a blowout. Show this voucher on your phone or bring it printed.
finePrint: New guests and first-time services only.
One voucher per guest. Not valid with other offers or on retail products.

referral.headline: A friend sent you $20 off your first visit
referral.text: Show this voucher at your first visit and tell us who referred you. You get $20 off, and as a thank-you, your friend gets a $50 Fusion 3 salon credit.
referral.shareText: I love my salon, Fusion 3 in Pleasanton. Here's $20 off your first visit. Just show this voucher and tell them I sent you:
finePrint: For guests new to Fusion 3 Salon. One voucher per guest.
The referring guest receives a $50 salon credit on their account after their friend's first completed service.
No cash value. Not valid with other offers.

team._help: Team members shown on the homepage and About page. Each card links to that person's booking page. To add someone: put a square photo in public/images/team/ and add an entry. 'role' is optional (e.g. 'Master Stylist').
team.intro: Click a stylist to see their services and book with them directly.
